punchline: Telstar went dark within months and still changed television.
thirty_sec: On 23 July 1962 the Bell-built Telstar 1, launched on 10 July, relayed live television between Maine and France; radiation damage ended its service by February 1963, but the demonstration was already done.
question: Which single claim about your project would convince the doubters, and what is the smallest live test that shows it?
key_contrast: Do not build for durability first; build to settle one doubt.
